يستمطرا (form X)
# يَسْتَمْطِرَا (yastamṭirā) /jas.tam.tˤi.raː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَمْطَرَ (istamṭara)
# يُسْتَمْطَرَا (yustamṭarā) /jus.tam.tˤa.raː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَمْطَرَ (istamṭara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
